item.title: How to Set HPA for Kubernetes Applications and the Related Parameters
item.description: 1. Business Background Once an enterprise reaches a certain scale, relying entirely on public cloud infrastructure makes IT costs very high. The cost of purchasing physical machines can be amortized over the next 3 to 5 years, and afterwards the machines are not scrapped; instead they continue to serve beyond their planned lifespan.

item.title: Hybrid Cloud in Cloud Deployment
item.description: 1. User Scenarios for Hybrid Cloud 1.1 Handling Explosive Business Growth Internet businesses grow exponentially, and it is hard to predict how much infrastructure capacity to reserve. Usually, for a long stretch in the early days of a business, a small colocation footprint of physical machines is enough to meet demand.
